about: Advisories that do not fail CI (scripts/audit.js), agreed by the owner. Only for an advisory with no fixed release that is in the build tooling only — nothing of it ships in the browser. Never Electron. Look again by reviewBy: after it, the advisory fails CI again.

exceptions.reason: ReDoS in glob matching; every published version is affected and no fix exists yet. Used only by node-gyp while packaging, on our own file patterns; not part of the installed browser. npm's only offer is a downgrade of electron-builder to 24.13.3.
